import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final char NL = '\n';
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;
    
    static final int TOTAL_TIME = 99;
    static final int MAX_COST_LEVELS = 15;

    static class MinCostFlow {
        static final int MAX_NODES = 50 * TOTAL_TIME + 2;
        static final int MAX_EDGES = 2 * MAX_NODES * MAX_COST_LEVELS + MAX_NODES + 7;
        
        int[] par = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] first = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] nxt = new int[2 * MAX_EDGES];
        int[] ep = new int[2 * MAX_EDGES];
        int edge_count;
        long[] flo = new long[2 * MAX_EDGES];
        long[] cap = new long[2 * MAX_EDGES];
        long[] cost = new long[2 * MAX_EDGES];
        
        int[] queue = new int[MAX_NODES];
        int[] in_queue = new int[MAX_NODES];
        boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAX_NODES];
        long[] potential = new long[MAX_NODES];
        long[] distance = new long[MAX_NODES];
        
        void initialize() {
            edge_count = 0;
            Arrays.fill(first, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flo, 0);
        }
        
        void add_connection(int a, int b, long capacity, long price) {
            nxt[edge_count] = first[ep[edge_count] = a];
            first[ep[edge_count]] = edge_count;
            cap[edge_count] = capacity;
            cost[edge_count] = price;
            ++edge_count;
            
            nxt[edge_count] = first[ep[edge_count] = b];
            first[ep[edge_count]] = edge_count;
            cap[edge_count] = 0;
            cost[edge_count] = -price;
            ++edge_count;
        }
        
        void potential_init(int num_vertices) {
            Arrays.fill(potential, 0);
            for (int iter = 1; iter < num_vertices; ++iter) {
                for (int e = 0; e < edge_count; ++e) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0) {
                        potential[ep[e ^ 1]] = Math.min(potential[ep[e ^ 1]], potential[ep[e]] + cost[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        long update(int source, int sink, long[] total_cost, int num_vertices) {
            Arrays.fill(visited, false);
            Arrays.fill(distance, INF);
            distance[source] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(in_queue, -1);
            
            int queue_size = 0;
            in_queue[queue[queue_size++] = source] = 0;
            
            while (queue_size > 0) {
                int u = queue[0];
                in_queue[u] = -1;
                queue[0] = queue[--queue_size];
                if (queue_size > 0) in_queue[queue[0]] = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0, left_child = 2 * i + 1, temp; left_child < queue_size; i = left_child, left_child = 2 * i + 1) {
                    if (left_child + 1 < queue_size && distance[queue[left_child + 1]] < distance[queue[left_child]]) 
                        left_child++;
                    if (distance[queue[left_child]] >= distance[queue[i]]) 
                        break;
                    int temp_node = queue[i];
                    queue[i] = queue[left_child];
                    queue[left_child] = temp_node;
                    int temp_in_queue = in_queue[queue[i]];
                    in_queue[queue[i]] = in_queue[queue[left_child]];
                    in_queue[queue[left_child]] = temp_in_queue;
                }
                
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;
                
                for (int e = first[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    int v = ep[e ^ 1];
                    if (flo[e] < cap[e] && distance[v] > distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[v] + cost[e]) {
                        distance[v] = distance[u] + potential[u] - potential[v] + cost[e];
                        par[v] = e;
                        if (in_queue[v] < 0) {
                            in_queue[queue[queue_size] = v] = queue_size;
                            queue_size++;
                        }
                        for (int index = in_queue[v], parent = (index - 1) / 2, temp2; 
                             index > 0 && distance[queue[index]] < distance[queue[parent]]; 
                             index = parent, parent = (index - 1) / 2) {
                            int temp_node = queue[index];
                            queue[index] = queue[parent];
                            queue[parent] = temp_node;
                            int temp_in_queue = in_queue[queue[index]];
                            in_queue[queue[index]] = in_queue[queue[parent]];
                            in_queue[queue[parent]] = temp_in_queue;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (distance[sink] >= INF) return 0;
            
            long augment = INF;
            for (int e, node = sink; node != source; node = ep[e]) {
                e = par[node];
                augment = Math.min(augment, cap[e] - flo[e]);
            }
            
            for (int e, node = sink; node != source; node = ep[e]) {
                e = par[node];
                flo[e] += augment;
                flo[e ^ 1] -= augment;
                total_cost[0] += augment * cost[e];
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < num_vertices; ++i) {
                potential[i] = Math.min(INF, distance[i] + potential[i]);
            }
            
            return augment;
        }
    }

    static MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow();

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        final int start_node = 0;
        final int end_node = n * TOTAL_TIME + 1;
        mcf.initialize();

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            mcf.add_connection(start_node, a, 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int time = 0; time < TOTAL_TIME; time++) {
            mcf.add_connection(1 + time * n, end_node, INF, 0);
            if (time > 0) {
                for (int node = 1; node <= n; node++) {
                    mcf.add_connection(node + (time - 1) * n, node + time * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int level = 0; level < MAX_COST_LEVELS; level++) {
                int cost_factor = (level + 1) * (level + 1) - level * level;
                for (int time = 1; time < TOTAL_TIME; time++) {
                    mcf.add_connection(a + (time - 1) * n, b + time * n, 1, cost_factor * d + c);
                    mcf.add_connection(b + (time - 1) * n, a + time * n, 1, cost_factor * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        mcf.potential_init(MinCostFlow.MAX_NODES);
        long[] total_cost = new long[1];
        total_cost[0] = 0;
        long total_flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            long aug = mcf.update(start_node, end_node, total_cost, MinCostFlow.MAX_NODES);
            if (aug == 0) break;
            total_flow += aug;
        }
        
        if (total_flow != k) {
            throw new AssertionError("Total flow does not match expected flow");
        }
        System.out.println(total_cost[0]);
    }
}
